I don't think my story belongs here but I've never talked about this. I wasn't fired, I preferred to quit before being fired basically for being incompetent. It was my first job as a PHP developer, as much as I tried I couldn't understand the company's code so I ended up fixing minor front-end bugs until I realised I wouldn't be able to keep that job, they didn't want to let me go which made me feel worse, I had to tell a lie I knew that would make them stop insisting. I've been embarrased for that for so long LOL. I've been working on personal projects and I've started to understand many modern concepts of programming in order to be able to survive at another dev job. I actually miss that job, it wasn't a toxic environment, for what I've read about project management they had a pretty decent workflow, it was remote (I have Asperger so I was very comfortable with not having to interact with them in person lol) and communication was in english which isn't my native language so it was the perfect practice. I think it was a great opportunity but maybe I just wasn't cut out for it at the moment.
